Code fix in freytag-forge (Python 3.12). Working directory: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. No network, no billed call, no uv: `export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_URL=https://w.example`, run `.venv/bin/python`. Do not git commit. YOU MAY EDIT ONLY: storygame/runtime/item_facts.py and tests/test_referred_reach.py. Never edit docs/, .plans/, bench/, data/. No story names in storygame/.

CONTEXT: ItemFactsProvider._thing_names (storygame/runtime/item_facts.py ~line 518) was just changed so that, when the protagonist is at the scene location and not seated, a name in self._referred_names that is out of reach is dropped (see git diff, and tests/test_referred_reach.py). GAP: the earlier loop in _thing_names expands names with `world.given_with`, `world.seats` and a parent's seats, inserting extra names (such as a vehicle's seats and an item on a seat) that are NOT in self._referred_names. When the vehicle (outside, out of reach) is dropped, its seats and the laptop on the seat still reach the narrator's THINGS. Live case: protagonist in the house, command 'Wait.', match reply refers the truck; the truck is dropped but 'passenger seat', 'driver's seat' and the laptop on the passenger seat stay.

FIX: in the in-scene branch, apply keep_name to every name that is not the protagonist and not in self.dependency_names(), not only to names in self._referred_names (selected names are only dependencies, the protagonist, referred names and these expansions). Names in reach, literally named, resolved, held, or dependencies stay exactly as today.

TESTS FIRST in tests/test_referred_reach.py: extend the synthetic story with a vehicle in a separate room that has two seats and an item on one seat; protagonist in the house; command 'Wait.'; match refers the vehicle: the vehicle, seats and item are all absent from THINGS. And a control: same but the command is 'Look at the vehicle.' keeps the vehicle (seats/item may stay if they pass keep_name; assert only the vehicle is present). Run, see the first fail, then fix. Report any existing test pin changed (expect none).
